out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located near the 3 vat sink is blocked by dishes being stored in the hand sink, preventing access to hand washing sink.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HAND WASHING SINKS CAN ONLY BE USED TO WASH HANDS AND NOTHING ELSE. PIC REMOVED THE DISHES FROM THE HAND WASHING SINK.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. A box of lettuce was being stored on the floor while being prepped and cut.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT FOOD IS NOT ALLOWED TO BE STORED ON THE FLOOR EVEN DURING PREPARATION. PIC MOVED LETTUCE FROM OFF THE FLOOR.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: CFM arrived during the time of inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the ware washing area being used to store utensils and gloves. Food debris also observed within the hand sink basin located in the food preparation area.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. The EHS instructed employees that hand washing sinks are only to be used for hand washing. Hand sinks not to be used as a dump sink or as storage for utensils.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. No hand washing signs are observed posted at all three hand sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.
